_meta.platform: oklahoma.gov Adobe AEM + one WordPress outlier (oid.ok.gov)
_meta.aem_pattern: Every oklahoma.gov newsroom page carries data-newslistingapiurl="/content/sok-wcm/...". Append .json and paginate with ?page=N (10 items/page, 1-indexed). Response: {totalCount, items:[{newsUrl,title,category,lastModified}]}.
_meta.date_caveat: The feed's only date is lastModified (AEM modify date, format 'Jul 20, 2026'), not a publication date. Read the real date off the detail page and set date_source accordingly.

excluded.secretary_of_state: sos.ok.gov -- APPOINTED by the Governor, not elected. Out of scope for an elected-official archive. Also serves an incomplete TLS chain: certifi fails, the macOS system trust store succeeds.
excluded.lieutenant_governor: ltgov.ok.gov resolves to 204.87.106.2 but refuses HTTP and HTTPS connections as of 2026-07-25. No live press surface found.
excluded.state_auditor: oklahoma.gov/auditor.html publishes press releases as PDFs only (./p/*.pdf), audit-specific, no dates in the listing, no news API. Needs the pdfplumber path if wanted.

_meta.party_note: Party affiliation is NOT published on any of these official .gov pages, so party is left empty rather than asserted. Source it from the Oklahoma State Election Board before load.

name_provenance.Gentner Drummond: body text of a live oklahoma.gov/oag release
name_provenance.Lindel Fields: pull quote on sde.ok.gov home page

_meta.notes: DRAFT. Not registered in pipeline/lib/seeds.py and not wired into the daily cron. Every officeholder name was read off a live .gov page on 2026-07-25; see name_provenance.

members.notes: sde.ok.gov soft-404s every unknown path to its homepage with HTTP 200. Always collect from the oklahoma.gov path.
Feed lives under a tabs component; the endpoint path is not the standard responsivegrid-second/newslisting.
Agency-level feed. Releases are issued by the Commission, not per commissioner; per-commissioner attribution is not available.

WordPress, not oklahoma.gov AEM. Item block div.news-list-item-without-image; title+URL in a > h2; category tags in div.post_categories; date in div.post-date-wrap is MONTH AND YEAR ONLY -- read the day off the detail page. /wp-json/wp/v2/posts returns 401. NO WORKING PAGINATION: /news/page/2/, ?paged=2, ?page=2 and the /category/ archives all return the same 10 most-recent items, so only forward collection is possible -- no 2025 back-coverage from this surface.
